from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialFigure(BaseModel):
    """A financial figure reported for a specific company in one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company this figure belongs to")
    stock_symbol: str | None = Field(description="The stock ticker/symbol if available")
    field_name: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the financial line item (e.g., '公允价值变动收益')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value as reported, with sign preserved")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount (e.g., '元', '万元')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_figures: list[CompanyFinancialFigure]
